pages.title: Documentation Home
pages.content:
# Documentation Home

This starter uses the `preview-data.json + theme/` workflow. Edit `preview-data.json` to change the example pages and edit files under `theme/` to change presentation.

## Included Features

- grouped sidebar navigation
- native static search
- page table of contents
- collection-based previous and next links
- Markdown tables, alerts, code blocks, and Mermaid fences

> [!NOTE]
> Sample content disallows crawling by default. Set `site.robots.allow_indexing` to `true` when your own site is ready for search engines to crawl.

## Start Here

Read [Getting Started](/getting-started), review the [configuration guide](/guides/configuration), or inspect the [Markdown examples](/markdown-examples/).

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.content:
# Getting Started

The generated project is self-contained:

```txt
my-docs/
  .gitignore
  package.json
  preview-data.json
  public/
  theme/
```

## Install And Preview

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

The development server watches `theme/`, `preview-data.json`, and the optional `public/` directory.

## Build

```bash
npm run build
```

The static output is written to `dist/`. The build command validates Preview Data v0.7 and Theme Runtime v0.7 before generating files.

## Next Steps

1. Replace the example site and page content in `preview-data.json`.
2. Set `site.url` to the production HTTP(S) origin.
3. Update `theme/theme.json` metadata.
4. Review menus, collections, indexing, and external assets before deployment.

pages.title: Writing Markdown
pages.content:
# Writing Markdown

Page and post `content` can use `document_type: "markdown"`. Build Core converts it to safe HTML before the theme renders it.

## Common Elements

Use headings to structure long documents, lists for related items, and fenced code blocks for examples.

```js
export function greet(name) {
  return `Hello, ${name}.`;
}
```

> [!TIP]
> Keep theme markup in `theme/` and authored document content in Preview Data.

## Links

Use root-relative links for routes within the generated site, such as [Configuration](/guides/configuration). Use credential-free HTTP(S) URLs for external navigation.

pages.title: Markdown Examples
pages.content:
# Markdown Examples

This page exercises the documentation theme's content styles.

## Inline Text

Text can include **strong emphasis**, _emphasis_, ~~deleted text~~, `inline code`, and [links](/guides/markdown).

## Task List

- [x] Generate the starter
- [x] Run the local preview
- [ ] Replace the example content
- [ ] Deploy the static output

## Table

| Input | Consumer | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `preview-data.json` | ZeroPress Build | Static routes |
| `theme/` | Theme Runtime | Rendered HTML |
| `public/` | Public passthrough | Trusted assets |

## Alerts

> [!WARNING]
> Do not publish private content in a static site.

## Mermaid

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  data["Preview Data"] --> build["ZeroPress Build"]
  theme["Theme Runtime"] --> build
  build --> site["Static site"]
```

## Native Media

The bundled public directory includes small local media fixtures:

<video controls muted playsinline poster="/media/video-poster.jpg" width="640">
  <source src="/media/video.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  <track src="/media/captions-en.vtt" kind="captions" srclang="en" label="English" default>
</video>

<audio controls preload="metadata">
  <source src="/media/audio.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
</audio>
